newsitem.title: USA: RJR's names David Rickard CFO.
newsitem.headline: RJR's names David Rickard CFO.

text.p: RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp said Wednesday that David Rickard, currently executive vice president of International Distillers and Vintners (IDV) Americas, will join RJR Nabisco as senior vice president and chief financial officer.
RJR Nabisco said Rickard will succeed Robert Roath, who is retiring after seven years with the company.
The company said Rickard has been executive vice president and chief administrative officer of IDV Americas, a subsidiary of Grand Metropolitan Plc of Hartford, Conn., since 1996.
The company said it expects the changes will be effective in mid-March.
